units.source_text: 洞穴的底部，有什么在晃动。

en.t: At the bottom of the hole, something was swaying.
Oh, it was his own shadow.

units.source_text: 紧挨影子的上面是囤水装置，木框的一边掉了下来。

en.t: Just above the shadow was the water storage device, and one side of the wooden frame had fallen off.

units.source_text: 大概是刚才搬动女人时不小心踩上去给蹭掉的。

en.t: He had probably stepped on it by accident while moving the woman earlier and knocked it loose.

units.source_text: 他慌忙返回洞底去修理。

en.t: He hurried back to the bottom of the hole to repair it.

units.source_text: 囤积的水正和计算预料的一样，到了第四格刻度。

en.t: The stored water, just as his calculations had predicted, had reached the fourth mark.

units.source_text: 看不出是什么大不了的故障。

en.t: It did not look like any serious malfunction.

units.source_text: 屋子里，收音机正用干燥的声音唱着歌。

en.t: Inside the house, the radio was singing in a dry voice.

units.source_text: 他好不容易才忍住没让自己哭出来，他把手浸到了水里。

en.t: He barely managed to keep himself from crying, and he dipped his hand into the water.

units.source_text: 他就这样蹲着，身子一动也不想动。

en.t: He stayed crouched like that, not wanting to move his body at all.
